intent: Vendor the bloom field, so brightness reads as energy in the system rather than as decoration. Warrant WG-WEB-011 (C, field-reactive) and WG-WEB-005 (C, full). Source row WO-0017. Outside the consolidation programme. Acceptance: (1) BloomField.tsx copied verbatim from PatterTech_Website into src/kit/ with a PROVENANCE.md naming the source repository and commit, per ADR-0003 Part 1; (2) mounted once in the root layout; (3) the [data-bloom]::after paint rule ported using the existing Cherenkov RGB, so no new token is minted; (4) data-bloom set on the ledger rows, panels, cards and buttons that WG-WEB-003 names as the console's containers; (5) the fine-pointer and reduced-motion opt-outs carried across exactly. Done when brightness reads as energy in the system rather than decoration. Tier proposal R1, anticipated factor size-threshold from derived signal diff-size; the copy reads a second repository on the same filesystem, which is declared as a capability and reaches no factor, because capabilities are context for the reviewer and side effects are what rule the tier.
notes: Claims widened from the two directory globs on the record to the exact files touched. The record's own acceptance (4) puts data-bloom on the console's container COMPONENTS, and those live under src/components/, which the original two globs did not cover. The widening is recorded rather than silent.

Deviation, criterion 3. The paint rule does NOT spell the colour as --ps-rgb-cherenkov-glow. That token holds a comma list, '51, 221, 255', so rgb(var(token) / a) expands to rgb(51, 221, 255 / 0.07), which mixes a comma list with a slash alpha and is invalid: the declaration is dropped and the field paints nothing. Writing rgba(var(token), a) does not survive either, because Lightning CSS normalises it back to the slash form during minification. Verified against a production build in Chrome. The rule uses color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-cherenkov-100) X%, transparent) instead: --color-cherenkov-100 is #33ddff, which IS 51, 221, 255, and is an existing token, so no token is minted and the ruled colour is unchanged.

Coverage limit worth knowing. data-bloom is set on the container COMPONENTS (Card, Panel, Button) and on the three dashboard ledger-row sites. Most of the console does not go through those components: 313 raw <button> elements and 209 inline rounded-*-border boxes bypass them. Lighting those means the WG-WEB-003 container migration, not sprinkling the attribute across 500 call sites, so it is left to that work.

Discovered, not fixed here: nineteen pre-existing sites in globals.css use rgb(var(--ps-rgb-*) / a) and therefore paint nothing at all, including .scanlines, .grid-bg, .text-glow-* and every .glow-* box-shadow. GlowSurface is affected too, since src/lib/theme.ts GLOW_RGBS holds comma lists as well, so the Card `glow` prop is a no-op. Filed separately.
